scope: Layout only: per-record audit blocks moved to peritheos/data/audits; a check headline added; identifier-derived report links omitted from sidecars and regenerated on load; the generic statements listed here removed. Coefficients, errors, covariance, datasets, sources and scientific classifications are unchanged.
layout_revision: 2026-11-16: bindings regenerated from the unchanged pre-split files for the v5 check-block and reading-order revision. check fields renamed (finding -> source_note, source -> source_check) and compared/why added; per-record default flags moved to the material default_records map (default_flags/added_default_records restore them); record files use the v5 reading order. layout 'v4' names pre-split files rendered with the v4 key order. Sidecars and before_sha256 values are unchanged.

evidence.reproduction.assessment.qualifi: This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.
No reconstructed coefficient table is recorded for this assessment; no missing values have been inferred.
evidence.scientific_validation.note: Independently checked against the cited primary publication (published article or official/author copy); no external software catalog was used as scientific authority.

record_text_revision: Free-text revisions after the split (label, notes, validity.notes, thermal.notes) keep every replaced original verbatim in the record's superseded_record_text sidecar block. A binding's superseded_record_text lists those record indices; recovery restores the originals and removes the block first. after_record_sha256 and after_audit_sha256 bind the revised files; before_sha256 values are unchanged.
check_text_revision: Curated check texts written after the split (scientific_validation.primary_source_check.record_note and scientific_validation.warning_reason, copied into check.source_note and check.warning_reason) are bound as check_text entries [index, {field: original}], original null meaning absent; recovery restores them before removing the check blocks. finding is never changed. after_record_sha256 and after_audit_sha256 bind the revised files; before_sha256 values are unchanged.
